Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

DeepSeekMath: Pushing the Limits of Mathematical Reasoning in Open Language Models (2402.03300v1) · paper method: Math-corpus decontamination removes segments matching benchmark 10-grams; shorter benchmark texts with at least three grams use exact matching.
